title: 8 Signs a Godly Man Actually Walks Humbly
caption:
8 signs a godly man actually walks humbly. Not just talks about it.

He asks the question instead of giving the answer. He takes the smaller seat without announcing it. He can be corrected by a man younger than him. Micah 6:8 doesn't put an age limit on walking humbly with God.

He does the job with no title attached to it. He tells the story with himself as the guy who needed grace, not the hero. He can look any man in the eye and still get on his knees before God. Sturdy in the room. Low before the Lord.
